description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeatureDefinition, verifying immutability, builder operations, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinitionTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior, correctness, and properties of ImmutableFeatureDefinition class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableFeatureDefinition is immutable and its component DefinitionIdentifier instances are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods of ImmutableFeatureDefinition work correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetBuilderWithNullIdentifier
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a builder with a null identifier throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifierFromBuilderReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the first identifier retrieved from the builder matches the one provided initially.

methods.name: getSizeFromBuilderReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the builder's size equals 1 after initialization.

methods.name: addIdentifierToBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that adding an identifier to the builder results in the expected list.

methods.name: addAllToBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that adding multiple identifiers to the builder works as intended.

methods.name: removeIdentifierFromBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that removing an identifier from the builder results in the correct remaining identifiers.

methods.name: tryToBuildFeatureDefinitionWithEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Ensures that building a feature definition with an empty builder throws an IndexOutOfBoundsException.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifierReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the built ImmutableFeatureDefinition returns the correct first identifier.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the size of the feature definition matches the number of identifiers.

methods.name: valuesAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Checks that identifiers are stored and returned in the order they were added.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON array.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that deserializing from JSON produces an equivalent feature definition.

methods.name: fromJsonOfEmptyArrayFailsWithException
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to load from an empty JSON array throws a FeatureDefinitionEmptyException.
